14.o: Bob is forced to spend time with one of his least favorite people, while Tina is entrusted with something very close to Jimmy Junior's heart.

15.o: A bad smell threatens a town tradition, so Tina, Gene, and Louise try to eliminate it themselves.

1.t: Starting School! Titan Junior High School
1.o: On the very first day of junior high, Eren oversleeps and is woken up by Mikasa. While rushing to school, he runs into several of his classmates. When they arrive at school, everyone except Eren notices something is odd.

2.o: Eren's homeroom teacher tells him that he needs to go collect the club admission form from Armin Arlelt who has been absent from school. On his way to Armin's house with Mikasa, they encounter an upperclassman who defeats a Titan with a single blow.

3.o: Because of Eren, Annie feels embarrassed about her favorite food, cheese Hamburg steak, so she gets angry and vows to defeat him at the dodgeball tournament. On the day of the tournament, though, he oversleeps and causes problems for his team.

4.o: Eren and the gang reluctantly go to their first club activities at the Wall Cleanup Club. The president of the club tells them that the survival of the club depends on them and orders them to clean all the windows in school as their first activity.

5.t: Studying Hard! Titan Junior High School
5.o: The results of the mid-term exam are in and Mr. Keith tells his students that those who failed the tests will have to take makeup tests the following week. Those who fail again will have to take refresher classes.

6.t: Love Letter! Titan Junior High School
6.o: Someone put a love letter in Jean's shoe locker. Since the letter isn't signed, he doesn't know who it's from, so he starts trying to figure out who wrote the letter. Will Jean finally get the sweet love life he's longed for?

7.o: Fed up with their upperclassmen's lectures and unreasonable rules posed on them, some of the Year 1 students go against their upperclassmen. Responding to their attitude, Levi suggests settling the matter by competing in the Sports Day games.

8.o: The Attack Junior High Scout Regiment holds a customary event called the Test of Courage. It sounds simple enough, participants just have to visit three classrooms in order and write their names on the board. At night, of course. Nothing to be scared of.

9.t: Sweet Summer! Titan Junior High School
9.o: The summer festival is coming up soon and Bertholdt asks Annie to come along. Knowing how Bertholdt feels about Annie, Reiner and Ymir try to help Bertholdt look good in front of Annie so that he can win her love.

10.o: Removal of the student council president results in an election for president. In order to win, candidates fight for a Newspaper Club member's notebook that Levi says has information all the Attack Junior High School students would want to know.

11.t: Clear and Sunny! Titan Junior High School
11.o: Year 1 Class 4 is running a cheeseburger stand in their school festival. Their neighbor is last year's winner, the Kamameshi stand, run by Rico's class. Though it's a tough battle, Eren's class is neck and neck with them. Who'll be this year's winner?

12.o: After their chee-burg stand was taken by Titans, Eren and the gang decide to fight back.

1.o: When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

2.o: With a new team member on board plus the arrival of Hardison’s genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

3.t: The Rollin' on the River Job
3.o: The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

4.o: One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

5.o: When a woman believes she is being haunted and runs from her home in terror, Sophie leads Breanna and Parker through a con to convince the two real estate scammers responsible to target Leverage HQ.

6.o: The Leverage team dives into the world of a high fantasy collectible card game with a devoted following to take down a pharmaceutical bad boy who is price-gouging drugs to fund his own house of cards.

7.o: The team takes on a brilliant software developer who is selling a groundbreaking facial recognition system that threatens everyone’s privacy except his own.

8.o: Sophie must keep her feelings in check when she discovers that someone has written a memoir of the team, casting himself as Nate – which leads an exiled criminal to kidnap Harry and “Fake Nate,” forcing the Leverage team to pull a heist.

9.o: The Leverage team’s Holiday good deed goes awry when their attempt to give a small-town librarian the spy-thriller adventure of a lifetime is interrupted by a shadowy spy organization.

10.o: The Leverage team sets out to discredit a lifestyle and wellness guru targeting desperate people and peddling snake oil instead of actual medicine.

11.o: The Leverage team explores the failing memory of a legendary grifter to try and find her greatest score before her abusive Elder Guardian gets his hands on it and takes over her life.

12.o: An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

13.o: Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for, before it’s too late.

14.o: Two local farmers are targeted by a hate group, but something more poisonous on the farm leads Team Leverage to a crooked green energy innovator and an old-fashioned Train Heist.

15.o: The Leverage team infiltrates an oil rig and a small-town trial to find evidence that a corrupt oil CEO is hiding a dangerous oil leak in the gulf, causing illnesses along the spill zone.

16.o: The team has to infiltrate the shadowy R.I.Z. to stop it from unleashing a worm that can take down the entire electrical grid, and they must use Harry to do it.

2.o: The formidable nature of Maggie Greene, as told by Lauren Cohan, the actress who plays her, with a look back at key moments from "The Walking Dead".

When a suspected heroin shipment that Doug and Robyn were secretly investigating turns out to be children’s bikes, Doug’s dream of becoming a detective fades into oblivion. Coerced into going to Mumbai to visit his father, Doug meets Priya Sehgal, a beautiful, passionate legal-aid lawyer. Together, they fight to uncover the truth behind a false murder confession, and while finding his stride in the busy city of Mumbai, Doug realises his failed case back home might have its roots in his homeland.

2.o: Priya introduces Doug to the case of a missing Canadian traveller with connections to the drug-smuggling gangster, Gopal Chandekar. When Doug learns that Gopal knows the location of the missing girl, he must race to prevent Gopal from achieving the next big piece in his master plan.

3.o: The violent death of an innocent man at the hands of one of Gopal’s henchmen allows Doug and Priya to infiltrate his inner circle. This enormous risk could prove fatal. Doug uncovers a vital piece in the puzzle and, in alerting Robyn, threatens to put her in serious danger. Doug is forced to make an immediate decision that has disastrous consequences.

4.o: In a desperate race against time in order to save the lives of thousands in Mumbai, Doug is reunited with Robyn and together they embark on the most dangerous of missions. Doug struggles to finally put the nail in the coffin of Gopal’s plans, and Priya uses her legal brain to try to put him behind bars.

6.o: With Ahmet's fate hinging on Halit's recovery, Esra uses Dimitri's key to travel in time and keeps encountering Halit under unexpected circumstances.

7.o: A ring found near Peride's body sheds new light on the identity of her real killer. George makes a treacherous deal with Sonya and closes in on Halit.

9.o: The Monster Math Squad help a group of little monsters figure out a game of musical chairs by knowing all about MORE. When the Squad arrives, the little monsters are trying to play.

17.o: The Squad is called by Stinky Feet Monster to help him find the ingredients for his annual footbath.

18.o: Miss Murkly is leaving her nephew, Muddle Monster, in charge of her muffin shop, but he gets everything so mixed up, she's hoping the Squad will come over and make her monster muffins!

19.o: Mr Googly Eyed Monster needs help to get his Wally Ball-y rolling again, so he calls on the Monster Math Squad!

20.o: Hoppity Monster loves the game Monster Hopscotch, with its ten squares, but he wants MORE squares to hop in, so he calls in the Squad!

21.o: The Abominable Fridge Monster has a real problem: he needs to be full of food for his picnic with Mr Cranky Pants Monster, but he can't fill himself up!

23.o: Picky Eater Monster is afraid he doesn't have enough time to make loot bags for his brother Persnickety Eater Monster's birthday party just the way he likes them. Can the Squad help?

24.o: Sydney Squid Monster is having a pink ink tea party, but she doesn't know if she's ordered enough mucky-ucky marshmallows for the party.

25.o: Falls Apart Monster is missing his nose after bumping into another monster, and he needs the Squad to help him find it!

26.o: The Squad offers to help some little monsters to get a bucking monster toy bucking!

27.o: The Squad are asked to be judges at the famous Fang Festival, and they quickly make their way to the local park where the Festival is taking place.

28.o: Garbage Monster calls the Squad and says he needs help making the teams for Monster Road Hockey.

29.o: The Squad need to help Mr Cranky Pants Monster deliver some fungus fingers, and to do that, they'll use math!

30.t: A Bungle At Barks And Stench
30.o: Mr. Cranky Pants Monster needs the Squad to finish putting away some toys for him, but he warns them the toys can be very fussy and hard to put away properly.

1.o: Doting dad Trevor Bingley arrives at a couple's lavish home to house-sit while they're away. A bee follows closely behind — and the battle begins.

2.o: Trevor tries to remember the codes to unlock the library and prevent further damage. Later, he must reschedule upcoming plans with his daughter.

3.o: A police officer checks in on things. Cupcake ruins her prescription dog diet with peanut butter. Trevor releases the bee outside — but not for long.

4.o: With Cupcake's help, Trevor finds a messy way back inside and deals major damage with a kitchen hand mixer before the police officer arrives again.

5.o: Trevor cleans up with a shower under flashy lights and a groovy soundtrack. Later, the bee leads Trevor to the couple's grand piano.

6.o: Trevor tries to repair more damaged art. After chatting with Maddy, Trevor becomes too preoccupied with the bee to notice art burglars have broken in.

7.o: The burglars reveal themselves at an opportune time. Trevor must take Cupcake to the vet after his bee trap doesn't go as planned.

8.o: Trevor gets behind the wheel of Christian's expensive car to head to the vet. Later, a desperate Trevor devises a way to get rid of the bee for good.

9.o: With Nina and Christian on their way back home, Trevor goes in pursuit of his unrelenting rival with blazing fury.

1.o: Yu-mi is the only daughter of a poor family, but she gets everyone’s attention due to her exceptional beauty and talent. At the place where she finds work in order to make a living, she meets Hyun-joo, a woman who was born rich, and Yu-mi feels a sense of deprivation.

2.o: Yu-mi gets a job by using Hyun-joo’s university degree and even imitates the way Hyun-joo lives. After marrying a promising businessman named Ji-hoon, Yu-mi is satisfied with her life.

3.o: Yu-mi runs into Hyun-joo whom she had completely forgotten about. After that, Yu-mi lives every day in anxiousness. Meanwhile, Ji-won starts to get suspicious about Yu-mi’s past.

4.o: As Ji-hoon reaches closer to success, Yu-mi also receives the attention of the public. When Hyun-joo finds out Yu-mi stole her identity, Yu-mi’s cornered.

5.o: The relationship between Yu-mi and Ji-hoon worsen, and a scandal about Ji-hoon’s private life is exposed. Meanwhile, Yu-mi is confused about her identity while also feeling guilty toward Hyun-joo. She believes everything’s going wrong.

6.o: Since Yu-mi can’t be controlled anymore, Ji-hoon plans to send her to a place where she’s cut off from the rest of the world. Yu-mi finds out about Ji-hoon’s plan and she also tries to execute her own plan through Ji-won.

1.o: Da-jung is alarmed to find bundles of cash inside a bag that an old lady left in her possession. Just as she's about to hand it in, she gets a call.

2.o: Dal-gu introduces debt-ridden Da-jung to Woo-jin, an old prison acquaintance. He decides to assist her when he learns of her circumstances.

3.o: Appealing to her missing father on TV draws attention to Da-jung. Woo-jin also appears on the show to look into the scam behind his mother’s death.

4.o: Woo-jin suspects one player of joining three teams in order to win the Minority Game. He tries getting close to the contestant named Traitor X.

5.o: Woo-jin catches Dal-gu red-handed trying to steal Da-jung's winnings. Later, Do-young invites Da-jung to participate in a magazine photo shoot.

6.o: Having escaped earlier danger, and with Dal-gu's help, Woo-jin sneaks into the game hall and imparts words of advice to an isolated Da-jung.

7.o: It's the President's Game; only those elected can make it through. Dal-gu, who has given up debt collecting, is chosen as a candidate.

8.o: Dal-gu fulfills his promise to distribute the funds among his supporters -- only to discover the safe is empty. Do-young points the finger at Woo-jin.

9.o: The show's producer meets Da-jung's father in secret, while Woo-jin suspects Do-young of being connected to past psychological experiments in the U.S.

10.o: Woo-jin tries closing in on Do-young by persuading three of his team members to join him. But Do-young has plenty more tricks up his sleeve.

11.o: Da-jung is shocked to discover that Woo-jin is the real cause of her father’s debt. The finals begin amid a mix of speculation and emotions.

12.o: Da-jung, Woo-jin and Do-young reach the final. Each harbors a distrust of the others as they point their guns, possibly loaded with live ammunition.

1.o: Pip, an orphan who yearns for a greater lot in life, has a chance encounter with escaped convict Magwitch that sets him on an unexpected path and into the clutches of the mysterious and eccentric Miss Havisham, who shows him a dark world of possibilities.

2.o: While Pip continues his education with Miss Havisham, he grows increasingly attached to her daughter Estella. In the city of London, the corrupt and powerful lawyer Mr. Jaggers gets a letter that will change Pip’s life forever.

3.o: Having left his life in Gravesend, Pip has a brutal introduction to London, working for Mr. Jaggers. Meanwhile Estella discovers a plan of Miss Havisham’s.

4.o: As London life begins to take its toll, Pip’s immoral work with Jaggers brings Estella back into this life.

5.o: Pip’s past comes back to haunt him as he wonders if he will ever take control of his own destiny.

6.o: As Pip and Jaggers’ plans come to a head, Miss Havisham finally comes face to face with her demons and Estella at last tries to break free after a family revelation.

1.o: It's 2008. Malena, 22, leads a lonesome routine in a city far from her home until a news story reconnects her to a traumatic past. In 2004, she attended a rock concert at the República de Cromañón venue. A fire broke out, killing 194 young people. The news confronts her with the guilt she feels for having survived and propels her to make a decision that will change her life.

2.o: It's 2008. Malena faces the difficult decision of testifying in the Cromañón trial and reconnects with an important object she had lost during the concert. The emotional shock triggers memories from the days before the fire. In 2004, she auditions as a guitarist for Los Peces Chinos — her neighborhood friends' band — and also grapples with guilt over a forbidden kiss.

3.o: Malena has an emotional and disturbing encounter, prompting her to open her old backpack. The objects she sees connect her to the first of the three Callejeros concerts, where the tension surrounding a forbidden love is reignited. Meanwhile, Bichito meets Javier, and the first signs of danger begin to emerge at Cromañón.

4.o: It's 2008. As Malena reconnects with Villa Celina and its streets, she stumbles upon a mural that brings back memories of the hours before the second Callejeros concert. In 2004, Nico and Lucas get into a fight, Luli receives unexpected news, and Bichito experiences an uncomfortable moment with Javier. Back in the present, an old friend gives Malena revealing information about Nico.

5.o: Everyone enjoys their last hours of happiness before the concert on December 30, 2004. Once inside Cromañón, a fire breaks out, killing 194 young people and shattering an entire generation of kids who enjoyed rock music. Additionally, moments before the horror begins, a revelation makes the triangle between Nico, Malena, and Lucas particularly unsettling.

6.o: The mothers and fathers of the young people in Cromañón receive the news of the fire and desperately focus on finding their children. In the hours and days that follow, the survivors must confront the deaths of friends and relatives. Overwhelmed, Malena escapes to the city of Rosario, while Carlos Binder begins to establish himself as a judicial figure within the Cromañón case.

7.o: Days before the start of the Cromañón trial in 2008, the debate over corporate and political responsibilities reopens. Malena makes an important decision and becomes involved in the survivors' organization led by Nico who she encourages to reconnect with his musical side.

8.o: Malena manages to turn a pivotal page in her life. Hours before returning to Rosario, an encounter with Nico makes her doubt her plans. For the first time, the future promises some light for her and for all her friends who survived.

1.o: بعد أن تشجعه ابنته التي تدعوه لخوض غمار تجربة جديدة، يستجيب الأرمل "تشارلز نيوندايك" لإعلان محققة خاصة تبحث عن جاسوس ليخترق مجتمعًا للمتقاعدين.

2.t: The Man Who Knew Too Much About Bridges
2.ar: الرجل الذي عرف الكثير عن الجسور
2.o: يسحر "تشارلز" أقرانه في السكن خلال تجمع لاحتساء الشراب بينما يتأقلم مع مهمته كمحقق. لكن أيتسبب تحذير غامض في إنهاء دوره قبل حتى أن يبدأ؟

3.o: يجد "تشارلز" نفسه مضطرًا لتبرير موقفه عندما تصل "إميلي" إلى البلدة بصورة غير متوقعة... فيما يتسبب غرض آخر مفقود بجعله هدفًا لطباع "إليوت" الحادة.

4.t: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Painting Class
4.ar: الواقعة الغريبة للكلب في صف الرسم
4.o: تمنح الأنشطة الجماعية في "باسيفيك فيو" "تشارلز" الفرصة المثالية لتقليص قائمة المشتبه بهم، لكن لطفه يثير مخاوف "جولي".

5.o: بينما تستخدم "جولي" هدية فاخرة كطعم للسارق، يحاول "تشارلز" مد جسور التواصل مع "غلاديس". أما "فيرجينيا"، فتشجع "فلورنس" على الإنفاق من أجل شيء لطالما أرادته.

6.o: بينما يعاني مجتمع "باسيفيك فيو" من صدمة جرّاء خسارة مفاجئة، يبحر "تشارلز" في رحلة عاطفية مع "إميلي". فيما تفكر "ديدي" مليًا في عرض مغرٍ من الإدارة.

7.ar: من سان فرانسيسكو مع خالص الحب
7.o: خلال جولة حول المواقع التاريخية في "سان فرانسيسكو"، يوطد "تشارلز" و"كالبرت" علاقتهما بتبادل الأحاديث عن الماضي والحاضر والمستقبل. أما "ديدي" و"جولي"، فتتشاجران وتهددان بعضهما.

8.t: The Spy Who Came In from the Cold
8.o: بعد أن تكتمل قطع الأحجية، يواجه "تشارلز" صعوبة في كشف الهدف الحقيقي من وجوده في مجتمع "باسيفيك فيو". من جهتها، تساعده "إميلي" على تجاوز الماضي.

1.o: عندما تصبح أسرار رئيس الكلّية في حوزة أيادٍ ماكرة، يتنكر "تشارلز" في هيئة محاضر زائر داخل الحرم الجامعي ليكشف هوية مُبتزّ مجهول.

2.o: بينما تستعين "جولي" بخبير غير متوقع ليتتبع دليلًا جديدًا، يجد "تشارلز" نفسه في موقف صعب تتقاطع فيه مصالحه المهنية والعاطفية.

3.o: يتحول الاجتماع مع "براد" إلى جلسة عصف ذهني فوضوية. وعلى صعيد آخر، تُستدعى "إميلي" للمساعدة عندما تساور والدها شكوك عميقة حول "مونا".

4.o: بينما تتصاعد ضغوط المُبتزّ ويظهر مشتبه به جديد، يجد "تشارلز" نفسه وسط تحدٍّ برّاق تفرضه التقاليد السنوية التي تعتز بها الجامعة.

5.o: تتسلّل الفوضى إلى اجتماع آل "نيوندايك" على عشاء عيد الشكر عندما تؤجّج المائدة المزدحمة بالضيوف وأزمة الفطيرة مشاعر الجميع تجاه روح العيد.

6.o: بعد نفاد الأدلّة، يتساءل "تشارلز" و"جولي" إن كانا يسيران في الاتجاه الخاطئ طوال الوقت، بينما تضع "مونا" و"إميلي" العمل جانبًا لأجل القليل من المرح.

7.o: يحوّل "تشارلز" لقاء زملاء الدراسة إلى عملية سطو محفوفة بالمخاطر ومكتملة الأركان بالأسماء الرمزية وخفة اليد وفريق متحمس من العملاء تنقصه المهارة.

8.o: عندما تتضح معالم قضية "ويلر" وتتكشف خيوطها، تنفتح أبواب جديدة للجميع تحمل معها فرصًا للمحققَين والمشتبه بهم على حدٍّ سواء.

1.t: The Legend of the Mix Master
1.o: Mad scientist Joeb attempts to mix Gamebridge City with the Game World. Meanwhile, Prince Brad - Evil Lord of the Game World - starts an invasion. In order to save mankind, a regular kid named Ditt must rise and become our hero, the "Mix Master".

2.o: Hench monsters have taken over Gamebridge City. Humans and Hench are on the brink of an all-out war. Our reluctant hero Ditt must restore order to prevent any more destruction.

3.o: Poy befriends an orphan hench named Penguinsa, and Prince Brad sends his minion Chino to intervene. Chino transforms Penguinsa into an evil attack-hench, leaving Poy helpless to defend herself.

4.o: Ditt's friend Penril is a well-trained Black Belt. When the dark elf Mino turns one of Penril's students against her, a practice fight becomes the real thing. In the battle that follows, we learn that Ditt may not be the only Mix Master.

5.o: Prince Brad and his goons are making life miserable for Gamebridge again. This time they've taken over Ditt's dad's office! What will happen when an ordinary Monday morning becomes Take-your-evil-Hench-to-work Day!?

6.o: Cheek is so eager to become a Mix Master that he falls victim to a slick Hench scam artist anmed Koala. Now, he will have to figure out who his true friends are before he can learn to be a real hero.

7.o: Ditt and friends enter a talent contest, but fall under a spell cast by Prince Brad's minion Chino and his punk rock guitar. With Gambridge in grave danger, Jin is their last hope, but he must decide if it is more important to save the city or see Ditt fail.

8.o: A special sports day is held, finally bringing humans and hench together for a friendly competition. But while Jin and Ditt are preoccupied with beating one another, the evil Jamine uses her mind control to quickly take control of the competitors.

9.o: Ditt and his friends try to help a group of overworked construction Henches, but Prince Brad's thug, Mino, turns them evil! Everyone must work together to stop Mino and teach the construction manager a lesson about treating his employees with respect.

10.o: An enthusiastic new teacher comes to Ditt's school, but his first day is ruined when the villainess Jamine brainwashes all of his Hench students.

11.o: Chino disguises himself as Poy and sneaks into Ditt's house to steal his Mix Master card shuffler. But Chino's plan gets ruined when he can't resist the home-cooked meal from Ditt's mother.

12.o: Penril brings Ditt and Jin together in attempt to make the boys reconcile. Despite their resistance, the boys must find a way to work together and save Jin's father, the mayor of Gambridge, against dark elves.

13.o: Dr.Joeb proclaims Ditt is the Mix Master, but Jin is determined to challenge him for the title. As the two boys engage in a Hench battle, the evil Prince's thugs seize the opportunity. Henches, action and the true Mix Master!

14.o: A reality TV show follows the daily lives of Ditt and Jin. In an attempt to be on TV too, Prince Brad's thugs attack the boys and the cameras capture an amazing battle, until something goes dangerously wrong, leaving Poy to become the star of the show.

15.o: It's a race to find the Master Hench. Prince Brad is running at full speed and so are Ditt and his friends. Who will be the winner?

16.o: Rumor has it that a celebrity Hench visiting Gambridge is actually the Master Hench! Ditt and his friends discover she's been brainwashed and her new movie is about to become a disaster flick unless they can save her!

17.o: When a mysterious Hench steals from Gambridge's rich and gives to the poor, the kids are convinced that this must be the Master Hench. But Prince Brad has the same idea and plots to get to the Hench before they do!

18.o: Ditt's classroom is visited by a guest speaker, a mystical Hench named Guru-Ga. It turns out that the Guru's mystical powers are not as advertised, and the kids must jump into action to save him from a Dark-Elf attack.

19.o: Ditt and his friends learn of a giant dragon living under Gambridge's streets. Rumor has it that this is the Master Hench. When the kids learn he is not, they must defend the helpless dragon from Prince Brad.

20.o: Dr. Joeb enrolls Ditt and friends in a bizarre training program to battle the Dark-Elves. Along the way, they find a collection of hidden artifacts, leading to Dr. Joeb's revelation of a long-kept secret of his own ancestry.

21.o: Prince Brad sends the evil Giara to defeat Ditt and his friends. Giara fills the town with flowers that turn into monsters. Ditt and his friends must counter the attack before the town is overrun with monsters.

22.o: A strange creature has been sighted out at the lake. Believing this creature is the Master Hench, the kids and the Dark Elves engage in a battle to reach it first, only to discover it's just Dr. Joeb in one of his latest and strangest contraptions.

23.o: When all of the kids have the same dream on the same night, they decide to follow the clues in the dream. They discover it was a trap set by Giara, and with no one left to save them, Pachi has no choice but to reveal his secret identity!

24.o: With his true identity revealed, Pachi is no longer safe in Gambridge. Fearing that he has put Ditt's family in danger, Pachi attempts to flee but ends up kidnapped by Prince Brad and his goons.

25.o: After nabbing Pachi, Prince Brad believes he has everything he needs to finalize the mixture of Atreia and Gambridge. But he didn't count on Ditt's resilience and determination to save both worlds once and for all!

26.o: In the ultimate battle, Ditt and Pachi use their powers to permanently put an end to Prince Brad and his evil plans. Although they win a the first battle against the Prince, Gambridge is no longer safe and Pachi must retreat deep into Atreia.

27.o: To bring Pachi back, Ditt and friends travel into Atreia and find a world filled with monsters and magic. Unbeknownst to the kids, Prince Brad has sent his field commander, Grom, to stop them.

28.o: Poy's mother has been captured by Dark-Elves, but the kids soon learn it's all part of Giara's plan to lure the group into an ambush. Ditt must try something that's never been done before if he's going to save them all.

29.o: Ditt and friends arrive in Poy's hometown, only to find hostile villagers reluctant to believe that Ditt is their hero. As Poy struggles to convince them, even Ditt begins to feel self-doubt.

30.o: To gain the elves' trust, Ditt and his friends do battle with an army of Dark Elves that threatens Poy's village. After proving himself, Ditt receives key help from the good elves. At their urging, he sets out to destroy the Ove, a mysterious artifact used by the Dark Elves to control the Hench and turn them into evil monsters.

31.o: With the help of the Elves, Ditt learns that the Master Hench has fled to a secret place called The Shrine of Ilyria. According to legend, only the Mix Master and his allies can enter this shrine which is located in the crags on a rugged mountaintop. Ditt and his friends set out in search of Ilyria.

32.o: Ditt and his friends arrive at the shrine of Ilyria, looking for Pachi. However, four powerful Guardian Hench protect the shrine from intruders. Ditt must defeat the guardians to prove that he is worthy to enter the shrine.

33.o: Ditt and his friends enter the mystical Shrine of Ilyria where they learn the truth about the legend of the Mix Master. At last, Ditt finds Pachi, but Pachi tells him he can't return to the human world. Before he can explain, Prince Brad breaks into the shrine and snatches Pachi away, proclaiming that he will take control of the Master Hench's infinite power and use it to conquer the human world.

34.o: Worried about their homes and families, Ditt and his friends return quickly to the human world only to find that it has changed drastically. While they were away in Atreia, Prince Brad used mind-control to turn the hench into an evil army. Now, Ditt and his group will have to fight their own Hench friends.

35.o: Prince Brad is preparing to harness the infinite power of the Master Hench. Ditt and his friends cross into the dark-elf world and try to intercept Prince Brad at his fortress. At the same time, Prince Brad's hench begin to mount dangerous attacks all over the human world.

36.o: Ditt and his friends break into the fortress and find Prince Brad and Giara who are draining Pachi of his power so they can use it for their own evil plans. Ditt tries to stop them, but Prince Brad holds him off as Giara laughs triumphantly: she has completed the process. But what Giara reveals next surprises even Prince Brad.

37.t: The Wraith of the Lost World!
37.o: The resurrected Wraith of the Lost World can bring the Human and Hench worlds to ruin with the force of his overwhelming power. In an attempt to counter this threat, Humans, Hench, and even the Dark-Elves - support Ditt and his friends as they prepare to rescue their worlds from doom.

38.o: Battling with the Wraith of the Lost World, Ditt's allies are defeated one by one until only Ditt and Pachi remain. Strengthened by their sincere bond of friendship and empowered by the faith of the good people of the world, Ditt experiences a miracle. The ancient Mix Master of legend awakens the warrior within Ditt, and Pachi suddenly recovers his powers as Master Hench.

39.o: Ditt and Pachi fight a mighty battle against the Wraith of the Lost World. With a supreme effort, they seal the Wraith away, back in his prison -- but his imprisonment will not be permanent until Atreia and the real world are separated again. To accomplish this, Ditt must go back to Gamebridge City and return it to its former state. His work as Mix Master is just beginning...

1.o: In the process of extracting oil at the drilling station in Gambridge, the Core Force receives a shock and the sealed Absolute Evil, Rout, wakes up. This accident creates the Mix Zone between Gambridge and Atreia and it is an omen that the world is going to collapse! The elders of Atreia send out the Master Hench to Gambridge to find four Mix Masters to save the world from this crisis.

2.o: While the Mix Masters are trying to change Ditt's mind, Ditt's partner Chichi thinks that it's all his fault. Ditt goes to the Atreia Forest alone to find the legendary Master Hench, Pachi, but gets caught by Babel instead. Ditt remembers his duty after saving Chichi and swears to save the world as a Mix Master.

3.o: The Mix Masters visit the zoo and give Master Hench a tour of Gamebridge. But Eva suddenly appears at the zoo and attacks them. She turns Sea Turtle Ally, Aring's closest friend, into a monster! Aring resists Eva with all her might and Ditt is touched by her devotion so he decides to try Extreme Fusion with her. Dinoking and Goldhawk successfully combine their powers for the first time.

4.o: Mir finds out that Ray's birthday is coming up soon. So Mir plans to throw a surprise birthday party at the amusement park with the Mix Masters and Master Hench. But Ray doesn't feel good about his birthday because his brother, who he always felt inferior to, died that same day. The Mix Masters get split up at the amusement park and Babel makes the most of his chance to attack the Mix Masters.

5.o: Moreen is born with the ability to predict the future. People ostracize her because they think she is cursed. But Moreen always stays cheerful and lives her life as best as she can. The Mix Masters find out about her past and help her become Top Master to complete their Mix Combination in their battle against Eva.

6.o: The Mix Masters take the Master Hench to Atreia to celebrate their graduation from Hench School. Ditt gets fooled by a fake Pachi that Eva made. A monch attacks him and chases him to the edge of a cliff. Meanwhile, Wolfman teaches a special training session for disqualified Hench. During the training session, Chichi senses that Ditt is in trouble.

7.o: Babel devises a scheme to create chaos in Gamebridge town by convincing Ditt's father to spread a contaminated fleshy plant. Ditt's father becomes a millionaire by selling Dayougi plants. He turns into a different man. Ditt finds out the truth and defeats Mandramonch, a dark mixed fleshy plant beast. But Ditt is still unable to vent his rage toward Babel.

8.o: After Ditt checks out the Red Temple, the Mix Masters have a meeting with the elders of Atreia. At the meeting, they find out the Red Temple is actually the main enemy base. So they set off on an adventure to find it. However, no one has ever opened the gate in the Mix Zone that leads to the Red Temple before.

9.o: The Mix Masters finally enter the "Door That Cannot Be Opened", but they find a steep cliff and a narrow bridge on the other side that leads to a dark forest. They enter the dark forest and accept the hospitality of Narsia, a butterfly Hench. But it's a trap and they end up trapped in the Insect Village jail.

10.o: The Mix Masters find their way to Man's Cave with Eva's map. But a suspicious beggar by the name of Kayon follows them. After a long journey, they finally arrive at a large train station. When they finally get inside the station, Babel stops them and tries to mix an earthworm and a cable car!

11.o: The entrance to the Red Temple is a twisted maze, making it hard to get in. Ditt tries to enter and falls into a trap. Chichi and Kayon get separated from the team and wander around in the maze for a while. Each of them solves a question to open the gate and finally end up back together at the final gate. The Mix Masters then defeat the Armor Knight to go deeper into the Red Temple!

12.o: The Mix Masters enter the boiler room that supplies energy to the Red Temple. Aring and Ray turn into stone after being deceived by the Hench that guard the boiler room. However, Ditt and Moreen find the passage that connects it to the Red Temple. The Mix Masters defeat Babel's Chainmon and finally enter the Red Knight's chamber!

13.o: The Mix Masters just barely arrive at the Red Knight's chamber. But when they get there, their Mix Launchers don't work! There is nothing the Mix Masters can do, so Kayon transfers to defeat Babel! Kayon reveals the truth about the Red Knight and the secret to the Red Temple.

14.o: The Red Knight who used to be a Mix Master gets completely dominated by Core Force, and the Red Temple gets transformed into Amoknight. The battle between those two and the Mix Masters gets more violent. As the battle rages, Amoknight threatens Ditt, Ray, and Aring's Mix Launcher power. The Mix Masters combine their powers to successfully Mix into a strong Delta Warrior and defeat Amoknight.

15.o: Things are peaceful in Gamebridge, and Gamebridge School is holding a school arts festival. Ditt's class prepares for a play: Snow White. Baba, the worst-behaved student in Ditt's class, bullies his classmates into giving him the leading role and letting him direct the others when the teacher is busy. But after defeating the Red Knight as a Mix Master, Ditt is not so timid anymore!

16.t: Here Comes the Dark Mix Master!
16.o: Gamebridge School is conducting psychoanalysis tests and Ditt accidentally puts what he thinks are the correct answers in the wrong place for every question. He gets sent off to Outcast Camp and meets Juho. Blue Fox hands the Black Mix Launcher to change Juho into a Black Mix Master. But when his hedgehog gets changed into a monch because of a disturbance, the Mix Masters come to the rescue.

17.o: Tomo is always being smothered by his mother who keeps a close watch on him. He befriends Moreen who notices his artistic talents. He enters an art competition and wins, but his mother isn't pleased. She tries to send Tomo away to study abroad. He becomes confused and upset. The evil Blue Fox takes advantage of his confusion, and transforms him into a Dark Mix Master.

18.o: Ray's childhood friend Yuna transfers to Gamebridge School. Yuna wants Ray all to herself, so she gets jealous of his friends. The Blue Fox uses her feelings to turn her into a Black Mix Master. Ray assumes the Top Master position to rescue Yuna. In the end, Ray lets her know his real feelings: he thinks of her as his good childhood friend.

19.o: This is the story of how the Black Mix Launcher was born. Blue Fox made the Black Mix Launcher with the remains of the Red Temple after the Mix Masters defeated the Red Knight. Blue Fox, disguised as a store clerk, gave the Black Mix Launcher to Youring, Aring's little cousin, to find out what the Black Mix Launcher could do.

20.o: Jina is stressed out because she thinks her face is unattractive, even though she is an awesome athlete. Blue Fox gets on Jina's nerves, takes advantage of her insecurity about her looks, and gives her the Dark Force Makeup Box. Jina fools everyone with her new Dark Force makeup, but Aring senses something is wrong.

21.o: On the day of the Gamebridge School trip, Hiro gets scared and sees ghosts even though other students can't. The Blue Fox exploits his fears to turn him into a Dark Mix Master and causes him to create a disturbance on the school trip. The Mix Masters combine their powers to purify Hiro.

22.o: Ditt cheats on his final exam in order to get out of having to attend supplementary lessons, but he ends up scoring at the top of the class and is selected to participate in a contest as the Gamebridge School's representative. Mino is the representative for River Town School and feels the pressure to win. Blue Fox uses his stress to turn him into a Dark Mix Master.

23.o: Wolfman, one of the members of council of elders in Atreia, starts an investigation into the mystery of the appearances of Dark Mix Masters in Gamebridge Town. Wolfman successfully infiltrates Blue Fox's hideout, but loses his memory. He makes a deal with the Dark Launcher and ends up fighting the Mix Masters! After being purified, Grandpung helps Wolfman get his memory back.

24.o: Luna is always jealous of the attention her twin sister Sunny gets from their mother. Blue Fox convinces Luna that her mother actually likes her sister more than her and turns her into a Dark Mix Master. Ray understands Luna's desire to be recognized by her parents, so he tries to save her. In the end, Luna gets purified and resolves her misunderstandings with her mother.

25.o: The Mix Masters cross the Mix Zone that Wolfman discovered and arrive at Blue Fox's hideout. They fight Lofa, the Monch that guards Blue Fox's place, and Blue Fox joins the fight. Ditt, Aring, and Moreen manage to force Blue Fox to bounce back out of the Mix Launcher. But Ray's sense of guilt about his brother's death changes the Core Force formula and turns him into a Dark Mix Master.

26.t: The New Dark Mix Master ... Ray!
26.o: Dark Mix Master Ray takes the Mix Masters to the Island in the sky Minus Ziggurat. They are in danger of losing their Core Force. Ray falls for Blue Fox's trick and thinks that he might be able to bring his dead brother back to life. He fights Ditt, Aring, and Moreen. But in the end, he feels the warmth of his friends' true hearts and frees himself from the dark Core Force.

27.o: After Ray becomes contaminated by the Dark Core Force, questions about his qualifications to be a Mix Master cause controversy in Atreia. In the meantime, Blue Fox secretly steals some Core Force and throws it into the Mix Zone, but part of the Core Force doesn't get collected. Because of this, Gamebridge and Atreia actually start mixing together.

28.o: After a Mix Zone is created between Gamebridge and Atreia, the two worlds fall into chaos because of many sudden unexpected changes. In the meantime, Moreen finds a fairy tale book that her mother often read from when she was little. A lady with silver hair suddenly appears in Gamebridge, and Moreen has a feeling that it is her mother.

29.t: The World is Starting to Mix
29.o: The Lady with Silver Hair drags Moreen to the third space. Moreen tries to find out if the lady is her biological mother, but the lady won't give her a straight answer. Meanwhile, the Mix Masters try to bring the Hench that came to Gamebridge through the Mix Zone back to Atreia. But they are mistaken for terrorists. Moreen senses that her friends are in danger and tries to return to Gamebridge.

30.o: After the appearance of the lady with silver hair, Moreen keeps wondering who her real mother is. She finds out that her mother disappeared when Energy R1 exploded in the lab. Meanwhile, the lady with silver hair mixes a Monch and disappears. As the Mix Masters are defeating the monster, they are caught on TV and they become instant stars.

31.o: Because reporters ran a story with a picture of what they said might be Moreen's real mother, people start saying that the lady with silver hair might indeed be Moreen's real mother. The Mix Masters fight the lady with silver hair who wants to abduct Moreen. After the fight Hench Hammerlong gets purified and tells them that Moreen's real mother had another child named Root.

32.o: Moreen's stepmother let the Mix Masters know that Root is R1, a type of energy with personality. Meanwhile, the appearance of Mix Zones everywhere throws Gamebridge and Atreia into chaos. Moreen fights back against Silver and wins thanks to support from her stepmother and the Mix Masters. Silver finally disappears and Root reveals himself thanks to a magic wand.

33.o: The Challenge Group send a robot to explore the Mix Zone and find out the structure of the connection between Gamebridge and Atreia. The Mix Masters realize this place is actually Root's hideout and go there to find him. Root and Battle figure out that the Mix Masters have discovered their hideout and run away to Gamebridge.

34.o: The Mix Masters enter Root's hideout one more time. When they do, characters from the fairy tale book, Foxy and Slow Red Knight, appear in front of them. The flying fairy tale book leads the Mix Masters into Root's Crystal Chamber. Root uses dark powers to dark mix Fox Knight. Root captures Ditt's soul in his crystal ball and steals his body.

35.o: Root kicks the Mix Masters out of Root's World and asks Ditt to take away his spirit completely. He tries to convince Ditt to choose his future after Root shows him a pathetic vision of what might happen. But Ditt chooses his own future even if it looks pathetic. Meanwhile, the Mix Masters use the Mix Launcher to find Ditt's location. They fight the gatekeeper sphinx to save him!

36.o: The Mix Masters find a vending machine that has capsules in it. They struggle to take out the crystal ball with Ditt in it and end up fighting the Dark Dinoking that is controlled by Root. Root tries to get rid of Ditt out of anger, but Moreen blocks his attack. Moreen falls down after getting hit. Root takes her and disappears.

37.o: The Mix Masters follow Root to his hideout to save Moreen. The Mix Masters end up using all their Core Force in the ensuing battle, but thanks to Pazzi, they are able to release the sealed Core Force inside the Ziggurat which collapses Root's world. They save Moreen and escape to Gamebridge.

38.o: Root gets angry at the Mix Masters, so he follows them to Gamebridge to destroy it. The Mix Masters decide to turn themselves into their Core Force to boost the power of their Mix Launchers. Fighters from Gamebridge and Atreia use their Core Force to combine their powers and create the Ultimate Guardian for the final battle.

39.o: The Mix Masters defeat Root with the Ultimate Guardian. The world finds peace at last. Root tried to create the world in his own image, but finally realizes the story that he knew was only half of the fairy tale. After Root goes back to nature, Core Force spreads around the world, allowing the Mix Masters to return to their normal lives... But the world soon faces another crisis.

1.o: Based on his excellent academic record, a poor fisherwoman dreams of her son becoming a government officer one day. DSP Maramalli is transferred to Thykara police station a week ahead of the highly competitive RPSE exams. Jhansi pulls off a high-risk stunt, leaving Maramalli helpless. A nervous Jhansi takes over as DSP. Can Jhansi's deception hold against the truth?

2.t: The Path to the Unknown Destiny
2.o: Reeling from the loss of his mother, the fisherwoman's son becomes disillusioned after a wealthy woman reveals how her son became a coveted government officer. In Thykara, Jhansi, guided by her mentor Jayachandran, starts investigating RPSE training institutions. Maramalli continues to fight a silent battle. Jhansi's mask is at risk when uninvited guests show up at the police station.

3.o: With his hopes crushed, yet his mind sharp as ever, the fisherwoman's son seeks Shanti Amma's help to land a new job. Jhansi convinces Maramalli's mother that Maramalli is on a covert undercover operation and must not be disturbed. Jhansi resorts to aggression to further unearth the scam. Maramalli gets crafty and makes a smart attempt to escape. Is it the endgame for Jhansi's deception?

4.o: The fisherwoman's son's life pivots as he takes up his new job near an RPSE Coaching Institute. Young Jhansi and Young Maramalli take up their RPSE exams, oblivious to what the future holds. Young Jhansi's life is thrown into a downward spiral. Jailer Jayachandran takes Jhansi under his wings.

5.o: The fisherwoman's son's ambition puts him at odds with a powerful man, and he begins to forge his own path. Jayachandran actively pursues a lead in investigating the suspicious suicide at an RPSE training institute. Jhansi uses yet another trick to close in on the scammers, and is stunned by the involvement of an unanticipated person. A phone call leaves Jhansi shattered.

6.t: The Fury of the Red Tea
6.o: Kumaresan's hidden past comes to light, revealing powerful connections. Believing they have finally figured out the scam, Jhansi's team sets an elaborate trap for the masterminds. But as they focus on their target, the real threat emerges from an unexpected corner. Jhansi and Maramalli are forced into a reluctant alliance to fight their way out.

7.t: The Fish That Hunted for the Duck
7.o: On the day of the RPSE exam, Jhansi discovers that she has been outplayed by Kumaresan's cunning plan. The walls close in on her from all sides, and she is left to fight for survival. Kumaresan's past deeds catch up with him, revealing a darker shade of the scam. Is justice finally served to Jhansi, or is she doomed forever?
